song: 57 - RAYE - WHERE IS MY HUSBAND! (Official Music Video)
title: magenta liquid, brass stabs, the mix turns
story: Big-band pop over drums: the liquid stays a club-magenta mix and each brass stab hits the golpe and a brightness lift; every kick lifts the agitation a little and each bright snare swings the centre left and right. Each bar sways the palette by a few hundredths of a turn. At the 4919 harmonic change (RMS dips, chroma turns) the mix swaps toward the second liquid over two bars, the hue steps to +0.08 and the contrast opens; after 4983 the drums return and the liquid settles into the same sway.
